ov: About 800 species of crustaceans that protect their soft abdomen in empty snail shells. Most live in the sea, and some live on land.

why.p: Common pets, often seen as throwaway ones, yet they can live 15 years or more; the record is 45.

rg: Almost all marine environments; some species live on land.

cf.tip: Unlike most crabs, a hermit crab has a soft abdomen that it protects in a borrowed shell.

fx: The oldest known hermit crab fossil is from the early Jurassic.
notes: Group entry. The existing fact is confirmed: hermit crabs form vacancy chains, queueing by size to swap shells in order. No why.p: the article doesn’t mention pets in my check.
